title: The Stinky Cheese Volcano and the Komodo Dragon Quest
summary: Tot the Mouse visits Bunsen's laboratory with a burning curiosity about Komodo dragons. Along with the energetic Isabella and the accident-prone assistant Beaker, they embark on a scientific adventure. After learning how massive these Indonesian reptiles are, the group travels to the local zoo to test Beaker's newly invented 'reptile perfume'—designed to help two feuding dragons become friends. Although the zoo experiment ends in a bitten bottle and chaotic retreat, the scientific spirit remains alive back at the lab. There, Isabella conducts a series of messy, unpredictable experiments involving baking soda, vinegar, stinky cheese, and a sticky slime known as 'gooey squid,' proving that sometimes the best part of science is the mess you make along the way.

characters.name: Tot
characters.description: A mouse friend who accompanies Uncle Bill and Seeker.

characters.name: Bunsen
characters.description: An obsessive chronometeorologist who views sleep as a luxury the world cannot afford, they spend their days and sunless nights tethered to a brass-bound "time wind tracker." With eyes bloodshot from perpetual vigilance, they monitor the shifting currents of temporal drafts, sacrificing rest to calibrate their instruments and fortify their laboratory against the encroaching gale of an impending storm.

characters.name: Beaker
characters.description: A high-strung Muppet and devoted companion to Bunsen, this jittery assistant—and close friend to Kitty—communicates solely through a frantic cadence of staccato "meeps" and "me-me" sounds. Driven by a nervous obsession with their work, they share a home with the scientist, remaining perpetually wide-eyed and sleepless until the day’s experiments reach a successful conclusion, pausing only for the occasional, coveted treat from the local bakery.

characters.name: Isabella
characters.description: A towering Dimatar scholar and alchemist of Atsukeeseet, Mama Izzy is a clever kiddo at heart and a steadfast guardian of rooftop gardens and intricate dollhouses. Gifted with the power of flight, she navigates the open heights with aquatic grace, her massive frame often shielded by a special protective metal that glimmers even as she descends into the shadows. As a resourceful quartermaster, she employs red flashlights, gold-laced slimes, and pipe cleaners to mend a Lanternshark’s failing light, yet her generosity remains her hallmark; she freely shares her vast library, brokers homes for dragons, and teaches others to find the resonance in their own voices. Her most profound magic resides in her vast, soft blanket—a sanctuary of ultimate coziness—where she remains a brave, quick-witted protector to all who honor her singular request for absolute silence.

characters.name: Daddy
characters.description: A helpful character who explains the immense size of Komodo dragons using 'Isabellas' as a unit of measurement.

places.name: Bunsen's Laboratory
places.description: A scientific workshop filled with chemicals, bathtubs, and the hub of many wacky experiments.

places.name: 71 Beach Street
places.description: Tot the Mouse's cozy home, located right around the corner from Isabella's house.

places.name: The Zoo
places.description: The home of two grumpy, beef-loving Komodo dragons who refuse to get along.

places.name: Indonesia
places.description: A far-off country on the other side of the globe where wild Komodo dragons reside.
